name: Narita International Airport

runway.v: runway A, 4,000 m long and 60 m wide; runway B is currently 2,500 m by 60 m

curfew.v: no take-offs or landings from midnight to 06:00 on runway A and from 23:00 to 06:00 on runway B, except in emergencies; a short flexible extension applies only for delays the airline could not avoid
curfew.quote: 24時から6時までの離着陸（ A滑走路）、23時から6時までの離着陸（B滑走路）で下記の事例に該当する場合、緊急事態（従来取り決め）が適用されます。

slots.quote: Slot application is necessary for flying business jets in Narita International Airport.

handling.v: Premier Gate, an exclusive terminal for business jets with its own customs and immigration; reception open 05:00-23:00; book its use by 15:00 (Japan time) the day before
handling.quote: Premier Gate is an exclusive terminal for business jets with CIQ facilities. ... Premier Gate Reception (5:00～23:00) ... ご利用日の前日15時までに

hours.quote: 1 成田国際空港 NRT RJAA 6:00～24:00 空港会社

missing: location (distance from Tokyo not stated on official pages read)
customs hours (Premier Gate has CIQ facilities; CIQ hours not stated)
slot lead time (slots via the Tokyo Regional Civil Aviation Bureau Narita coordinating office, phone 24 hours; no lead time stated)
notes: Curfew times come from the NAA Japanese curfew page (no page date; it cites the change of 27 Oct 2019). Flexible operation: runway A 24:00-24:30, runway B 23:00-24:00, only for unavoidable delays. Runway B also has a limit of 10 movements between 22:00 and 23:00. Narita's runway B extension and new runway C are planned; re-check the curfew page before publishing. Handling_list is for internal use only (the website names no companies). NAA also asks operators to send aircraft, insurance and other documents before flying in (naa-bj-private-docs); no deadline is stated. | 2026-10-31 run: IATA NRT and operating hours 06:00-24:00 from the MLIT designated-airport table (as of R8.10 = Oct 2026, jp-mlit-bizjet). Premier Gate reception hours from the undated NAA Premier Gate guide PDF (naa-premiergate-guide); same-day booking deadline from the NAA Japanese Premier Gate how-to-use page (naa-premiergate-app, no date). Both handling sources listed in src_extra. NAA stand-vacancy page: slots and stands are coordinated by the Tokyo Regional Civil Aviation Bureau Narita office (ATS Flight Information Officer Operations Room), contact 24 hours; no lead time. An undated MLIT overview (mlit.go.jp/koku/content/001446649.pdf, latest entry 2017) gives older facts (no daily business-jet movement limit since Oct 2011, parking up to 30 days); not used.
